summary:
BEYOND MARS is an interactive 3D educational survival game designed for children aged 7–12, introducing them to astronaut life and the challenges of exploring Mars.

Players must survive for seven days at a Martian research base, accompanied by Percy, a friendly robotic dog. They explore the Red Planet, manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, energy, and health, and complete challenges involving rock sample collection, crop cultivation, ice processing, and protection against dust storms and radiation.

Inspired by NASA's scientific discoveries and space exploration technologies, BEYOND MARS transforms complex scientific concepts into an engaging learning experience. Through exploration, resource management, and problem-solving, the game encourages critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and responsible decision-making while helping children understand the challenges of future human missions to Mars.
details:
BEYOND MARS – Project Details

BEYOND MARS is an interactive 3D survival and educational game that simulates the challenges of establishing and maintaining a human research base on Mars. Designed primarily for children aged 7–12, it combines exploration, scientific experiments, resource management, and decision-making in an immersive Martian environment.

How does it work?

Players take the role of an astronaut and must complete a seven-day survival mission on Mars, joined by Percy, a friendly robotic companion. They can explore the Martian landscape, enter different research facilities, interact with equipment, collect geological samples, and complete scientific activities.

The game includes several interconnected systems:

  • Life Support: Monitor oxygen, water, food, health, and energy to keep the astronaut alive.
  • Scientific Research: Analyze Martian rock samples, investigate the environment, and learn about real NASA instruments.
  • Oxygen Production: Operate a simplified MOXIE-inspired system that demonstrates how oxygen can be produced from carbon dioxide.
  • Food Production: Manage a greenhouse and grow crops to support the mission.
  • Water Resources: Collect and process Martian ice to obtain water.
  • Energy Management: Use solar power and make decisions about electricity consumption.
  • Environmental Protection: Reacts to dust storms, radiation alerts, and challenging Martian conditions.
  • Communication: Experience the challenges of communicating with Earth when signals take several minutes to travel between planets.

Educational Benefits and Expected Impact

BEYOND MARS makes space science more accessible through interactive learning rather than passive reading. Children discover why astronauts need oxygen, water, food, energy, radiation protection, and scientific equipment to survive beyond Earth.

The project aims to encourage scientific curiosity, critical thinking, environmental awareness, teamwork, and problem-solving. It also introduces players to the importance of scientific research and the technologies needed for future human exploration of Mars.

NASA Science and Real-World Inspiration

The game incorporates educational explanations inspired by real NASA missions and scientific instruments, including:

  • MOXIE, which demonstrated oxygen production from the Martian atmosphere aboard the Perseverance rover.
  • MEDA, which studies Martian weather and environmental conditions.
  • RAD, which measures radiation in the Martian environment and during space travel.
  • The Phoenix Mars mission, which confirmed the presence of ice.
  • The Mars 2020 Perseverance mission and its exploration of Jezero Crater.

The game uses simplified values and simulated scenarios for educational purposes; it does not claim to reproduce real-time mission measurements or an exact scientific simulation.

Technologies and Development Tools

The project was developed as a self-contained web application using:

  • HTML5 for the structure and interface.
  • CSS3 for visual design, responsive interface elements, and animations.
  • JavaScript for game logic, interactions, resource management, and simulation systems.
  • WebGL for rendering the interactive 3D Martian environment.
  • Canvas API for 2D interface elements, textures, and visual effects.
  • Browser-based audio features for sound effects and interactive feedback.

The 3D engine is custom-built in JavaScript without relying on external 3D libraries.

Creativity and Innovation

The project's creative approach is to transform the challenges of a real space exploration mission into an accessible survival adventure for children. Instead of simply presenting facts about Mars, it allows players to experience interconnected challenges and understand how every decision affects the mission.

The combination of a 3D environment, a robotic companion, interactive research facilities, scientific experiments, survival mechanics, and NASA-inspired educational content creates an engaging way to discover the Red Planet.

BEYOND MARS seeks to inspire the next generation of explorers, scientists, and engineers by making the future of human exploration an experience they can play, understand, and enjoy.
